note: Version 2 merges the merchants' requirements forms (2026-10-20 and 2026-10-21) with measurements usual in tailoring for the same garments. `iso_8559_1` names the closest ISO 8559-1:2017 clause as cited by Bodygram's measurement definitions; the standard itself has not been checked. Measurements marked 'Women' are left blank for men.

reference_measurements.name: stature
reference_measurements.description: Standing height, barefoot, heels together, looking straight ahead: floor to the top of the head.

reference_measurements.name: neck_base_circumference
reference_measurements.description: Around the base of the neck where a collar sits, over the bone at the back of the neck and the top of the breastbone at the front.

reference_measurements.name: shoulder_width
reference_measurements.description: Across the back from the left to the right shoulder point (the bony tip of each shoulder), following the body surface.

reference_measurements.name: chest_circumference
reference_measurements.description: Horizontal around the fullest part of the chest or bust, under the armpits, breathing normally.

reference_measurements.name: under_bust_circumference
reference_measurements.description: Women: horizontal around the ribcage directly below the bust.

reference_measurements.name: waist_circumference
reference_measurements.description: Horizontal around the natural waist: the narrowest part of the torso between the lowest rib and the top of the hip bone.

reference_measurements.name: trouser_waist_circumference
reference_measurements.description: Horizontal around the body at the top of the hip bones, where men's traditional trousers sit.

reference_measurements.name: hip_circumference
reference_measurements.description: Horizontal around the fullest part of the buttocks, feet together.

reference_measurements.name: thigh_circumference
reference_measurements.description: Horizontal around the fullest part of the upper thigh, just below the crotch.

reference_measurements.name: knee_circumference
reference_measurements.description: Around the knee at the middle of the kneecap, leg straight, weight on both feet.

reference_measurements.name: calf_circumference
reference_measurements.description: Horizontal around the fullest part of the calf, weight on both feet.

reference_measurements.name: ankle_circumference
reference_measurements.description: Around the narrowest part of the lower leg, just above the ankle bones.

reference_measurements.name: upper_arm_circumference
reference_measurements.description: Around the fullest part of the upper arm, arm relaxed at the side, tape at right angles to the arm.

reference_measurements.name: wrist_circumference
reference_measurements.description: Around the wrist over the wrist bones.

reference_measurements.name: arm_length
reference_measurements.description: From the shoulder point down the outside of the straight, relaxed arm to the wrist bone.

reference_measurements.name: neck_to_bust_point_length
reference_measurements.description: Women: from the side neck point (where the shoulder meets the neck) straight down to the bust point, the most prominent point of the bust.

reference_measurements.name: bust_point_separation
reference_measurements.description: Women: straight across from one bust point to the other.

reference_measurements.name: front_waist_length
reference_measurements.description: From the side neck point (where the shoulder meets the neck) down over the bust or chest point to the natural waist.

reference_measurements.name: back_waist_length
reference_measurements.description: From the bone at the back of the base of the neck straight down the spine to the natural waist.

reference_measurements.name: waist_to_knee_length
reference_measurements.description: From the natural waist at the side of the body, over the hip, straight down to the middle of the kneecap.

reference_measurements.name: waist_to_ankle_length
reference_measurements.description: From the natural waist at the side of the body, over the hip, straight down to the outer ankle bone.

reference_measurements.name: trouser_waist_to_ankle_length
reference_measurements.description: From the top of the hip bone at the side of the body, over the hip, straight down to the outer ankle bone.

reference_measurements.name: inside_leg_length
reference_measurements.description: From the crotch straight down the inside of the leg to the level of the outer ankle bone.

reference_measurements.name: body_rise
reference_measurements.description: Sitting upright on a hard, flat chair: at the side of the body, from the top of the hip bone straight down to the chair seat.

comparisons.note: The API measures a straight line between shoulder-joint landmarks (x 1.1); the tape follows the back between the shoulder points.
The API measures only the vertical drop from the shoulder to the wrist landmark.
The API measures from the hip-joint landmark to the ankle landmark; the tape starts higher, at the top of the hip bone, and follows the hip, so a systematic gap is expected.
